name: Bergbahnen Engelberg-Trubsee-Titlis AG
summary: Bergbahnen Engelberg-Trübsee-Titlis AG operates as a cableway and tourism company in Switzerland. It operates cableways and lift systems, restaurants, and shops, as well as Trübsee Alpine lodge, hotel TERRACE, and TITLIS resort in Engelberg. The company was founded in 1913 and is based in Engelberg, Switzerland.
